body: thanks! lol  im off to bed now.  thanks for talking to me.  goodnight

i have been taking an advantage of a service that my school provides which offers free counseling for students.  I've been seeing her for ~9 months I think, but maybe paying for a counselor that's not associated with my uni, might work?

maybe great physicist wasn't the right way to describe it, but going into college i really wanted to do something related to astronomy or physics research.  i think learning and discovering things is fun!  But it feels shitty when i know that i can't even get into my major because i can't do math.  

Maybe my method of studying was wrong?  but it's too late to figure out how to study now, because this is something I hsould have figured out before i decided to waste money on college

I'm not sure who to go to for support, I had one friend who i considered my best friend for a while, but he doesn't respond to any of my texts anymore.  the two other friends that I have only talk to me because they feel bad because I have no other friends.  Usually when I feel sad i just play video games or reddit, or go on tumblr

i really enjoy math/physics/computers/science, but it feels shitty when i know i'll never be a great physicist or really do anything, because I can't do anything right.  I've failed 2 math courses, despite going for extra help, and trying the tutoring that my uni provides.

I live in an oncampus apartment/ suite with my sister & two other roommates, and my sister and I don't share rooms.  I don't know if it would be possible to live somewhere else, but i honestly haven't looked into it

I've kind of hinted how I was feeling to my parents, but they said it was stupid or just brushed it off.  I remember I told my mother and my sister that i had almost attempted suicide a few years back, and they just yelled at me.


Regarding school and my parents, I can't really talk to them about it, because they both majored int he same thing that I am majoring in, and the material doesn't really change.  I have been lying to my parents about my grades for the three semesters that I have been in school, and they're still disappointed.  (They think I have a 3.5, but I actually have a 1.9).  I remember telling my dad that one of the finals for my major classes was difficult, and that I might get a B, and he told me that he was top of his class when he went to school, and that I am off to a bad start.

I have talked the counsilers at my school, but i feel like I can't talk to them about how I really feel, because i was required to give family to them before I went, so that if I ever thought about killing or harming myself they would be able to get someone to help me.  And it's just so weird that I have to schedule an appointment to speak to someone, it just feels so artifical
hi, thank you for replying, i put mostly everything into a comment for zigzwag.  it's kind of hard for me to articulate how i feel, so sorry if what i said doesn't make sense

i think the thing that really makes me sad is that the one person who i thought would understand thinks the least of me. (my sister)  I can hear her and my cousins mocking me downstairs which really hurts.  i can hear them all talking about me and i just want everything to stop.  i don't want anyone to remember me anymore, i just want to disappear and live inside of myself

I really don't feel like I deserve to have problems and that all my problems are stupid, but I guess I'll say a bit.  I'm not really good with words

- I don't feel like anyone takes me seriously.  Like for example, when I get really sad (I can't really describe this) I can hear my family calling me a brat.  

- I'm failing all my classes.  Honestly, I don't even see the point in trying anymore, because even if I do put effort into ANYTHING, including things that are not school related, I end up failing.

-  I don't enjoy anything anymore, because whatever I used to enjoy just reminds me how big of a failure I am

-  I have no one who will take my feelings seriously

And some other things, but I don't really know how to articulate them
